as_told.title: Soldier Marco Chereze dies after capturing a being

plain: In 1996, in the town of Varginha in Brazil, several people said they saw a strange creature, and some said it was captured. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a man named Marco Chereze who, in this story, handled the creature, found an oily, greasy substance on his body, and later died. If true, it would suggest that contact with the being itself was harmful.
